name: AN/WLD-1 Remote Minehunting System
def: Remote controlled mine hunting system from Lockheed Martin in which an unmanned semisubmersible vehicle tows a sonar array under the direction of a surface warship.
facts: Uses the US Navy's Snorkeler class unmanned surface vehicle
Control equipment is carried aboard the parent ship
